topic_title: Traffic Flow Management — Control Devices & Law
prompt: What is the primary function of electronic ramp metering signals positioned on Texas freeway on-ramps?

options.text: Inspect commercial vehicles for illegal cargo weight violations before entering
Collect automated municipal toll fees electronically from highway motorists
Break platoons of entering cars into single vehicles to merge smoothly into traffic
Measure vehicle exhaust emissions to verify compliance with state clean air laws
